title: Hunter × Hunter 2011 Pilot
notes: Granular episode facts use the cited secondary episode/character references because official distributor pages generally expose metadata and short synopses rather than scene-level mechanics.

One question remains explicitly marked review where the available source did not expose a precise episode number; it is retained in the 75-question pilot but should be manually confirmed before calling the full bank publication-ready.

questions.prompt: In episode 1, what natural sign does Gon cite when warning the ship's captain that a violent storm is approaching?
options: The sea birds are warning one another
The tide has suddenly stopped moving
Lightning is visible beyond the horizon
The ship's compass is spinning
questions.explanation: Gon says the sea birds flying above the ship are warning each other, and he confirms the storm by smell.

questions.prompt: At the masked villagers' two-choice riddle in episode 2, what response does Kurapika recognize as the correct way to proceed?
options: Choose the path toward Zaban City
Choose the path toward the cedar tree
Answer that the travelers should decide for themselves
Remain silent
questions.explanation: The riddle has no meaningful yes-or-no answer; the correct response is silence, which avoids wasting the answer.

questions.prompt: What alternate name does Satotz give the Milsy Wetlands in episode 4?
options: The Hunter's Marsh
Swindlers' Swamp
The Great Stamp Preserve
The Blacklist Fen
questions.explanation: After the long run, Satotz identifies the dangerous wetlands as the Milsy Wetlands, also called Swindlers' Swamp.

questions.prompt: In the original Second Phase task in episode 6, what animal must the examinees hunt for their pork dish?
options: A Great Stamp
A Spider Eagle
A Kiriko
A Man-faced Ape
questions.explanation: Menchi and Buhara require meat from a Great Stamp, described as the world's wildest and most carnivorous boar.

questions.prompt: After Menchi's first Second Phase is annulled, what does the retest at Split Mountain require examinees to obtain?
options: Great Stamp tusks
Spider Eagle eggs
A Hunter license from Netero
A badge from another applicant
questions.explanation: Menchi's retest is to retrieve the rare Spider Eagle eggs, also called dream eggs, from webs over the ravine.

questions.prompt: During Netero's airship challenge in episode 7, what does he promise Gon and Killua if they take the ball from him?
options: They will skip directly to the Final Phase
They will automatically become Hunters
They will receive a second Hunter license
They may choose the next examiner
questions.explanation: Netero says that successfully taking the ball from him will make them Hunters automatically; the challenge is not a formal exam phase.

source.title: Showdown × On The × Airship (Episode 7, 2011 anime) — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: What time limit does Beans state for reaching the bottom of Trick Tower in the Third Phase?
options: 24 hours
48 hours
72 hours
Seven days
questions.explanation: The Third Phase requires the candidates to reach the bottom of Trick Tower alive within 72 hours.

questions.prompt: Why does Gon's candle begin burning faster during his match with Sedokan?
options: Sedokan secretly lights a second wick
Gon chose the longer candle, which was oil-soaked
The tower's wind reaches only Gon's candle
The candle is made from Spider Eagle wax
questions.explanation: Gon chooses the longer candle, not knowing it has been soaked in oil; it therefore burns down faster.

questions.prompt: Why must Gon, Killua, Kurapika, Leorio, and Tonpa form a five-person group to advance in Trick Tower?
options: The tower's lift holds exactly five people
The prisoners will only fight teams of five
Their chosen route uses majority-rule voting
The Third Phase requires five Hunter licenses
questions.explanation: They enter the majority-rule route, where decisions are made by voting, so Lippo's rules require five members.

questions.prompt: At the final Trick Tower fork in episode 12, what is the stated trade-off for choosing the O-marked route?
options: It lets five people pass but takes at least 45 hours
It lets three people pass but takes at least 45 hours
It lets five people pass but takes only three minutes
It lets one person pass and awards six points
questions.explanation: The O route is long and difficult but allows all five to pass and requires a minimum of 45 hours; the group later breaks through the wall to save time.

source.title: Last × Test Of × Resolve! (Episode 12, 2011 anime) — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: According to the final-phase format explained in episode 19, what does a remaining examinee need in order to pass?
options: Three wins without being injured
One win, with losers moving up the bracket
The most points from collecting badges
A unanimous vote from the other examinees
questions.explanation: The Chairman explains that each contestant needs only one win; the loser moves up the bracket until one applicant fails to pass.

source.title: Can't Win × And × Can't Lose (Episode 19, 2011 anime) — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: Who is identified as the first applicant to pass the 287th Hunter Exam in the 2011 anime?
options: Kurapika
Killua
Gon
Hanzo
questions.explanation: After Hanzo concedes their match, Gon is explicitly described as the first applicant to pass the 287th exam.

source.title: Can't Win × And × Can't Lose (Episode 19, 2011 anime) — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: In episode 20, who is revealed to be hiding behind the examinee name Gittarackur?
options: Milluki Zoldyck
Illumi Zoldyck
Silva Zoldyck
Zeno Zoldyck
questions.explanation: During Killua's match, Gittarackur is revealed to be his older brother Illumi, who has altered his appearance.

source.title: Baffling × Turn Of × Events (Episode 20, 2011 anime) — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: According to Zebro in episode 22, how much does one door of the Zoldyck estate's Testing Gate weigh?
options: 500 kilograms
One ton
Two tons
Sixteen tons
questions.explanation: Zebro demonstrates that the first door weighs two tons; the larger total figures refer to multiple opened levels, not one door.

questions.prompt: In Gotoh's coin-guessing game in episode 25, how much time does a player have to answer each guess?
options: One second
Three seconds
Ten seconds
Until the coin stops spinning
questions.explanation: Gotoh states that a player has only three seconds to answer; a wrong answer eliminates that player, while exceeding the time limit triggers the stated threat.

source.title: Can't See × If × You're Blind (Episode 25, 2011 anime) — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: During Wing's water-divination demonstration, what does the water do when Gon performs it?
options: The water overflows from the glass
The leaf spins rapidly
The water changes color
The water becomes salty
questions.explanation: Gon's aura makes the water overflow, identifying him as an Enhancer.

questions.prompt: What sensory change occurs in the water when Killua performs water divination?
options: It tastes sweet
It becomes bitter
It starts to boil
It gives off a metallic smell
questions.explanation: Killua makes the water taste sweet, the sign of a Transmuter in Wing's demonstration.

questions.prompt: Which Nen category does Wing's water divination identify for Zushi?
options: Enhancement
Transmutation
Manipulation
Conjuration
questions.explanation: The leaf moves on top of the water for Zushi, indicating Manipulation.

questions.prompt: What does Gyo let Gon and Killua see during their Heavens Arena training?
options: Hidden Nen and aura
Future events
A person's memories
The exact Nen category of anyone nearby
questions.explanation: Wing teaches Gyo as a technique that concentrates aura in the eyes so hidden Nen can be seen.

questions.prompt: In Gon's rematch with Gido, what does Gon's fishing-rod hook catch to disrupt Gido's spinning?
options: A ceiling beam
One of the ring's flagstones
Gido's metal peg
The referee's platform
questions.explanation: Gon hooks a flagstone in the ring and flips it upward, leaving Gido vulnerable and allowing Gon to break his prosthetic leg.

questions.prompt: How does Killua turn Riehlvelt's Twin Snake whips against him?
options: He catches both whips, then pulls Riehlvelt into the air while the electrical attack is active
He cuts the whips with a card and pins Riehlvelt to the wall
He uses Gyo to make the whips disappear
He grabs the wheelchair and wins by stopping the match before contact
questions.explanation: Killua catches both whips, withstands their electricity, and uses them to hurl and then catch Riehlvelt, winning the fight.

questions.prompt: How does Gon make Riehlvelt pass out in their 200th-floor match?
options: He breaks the wheelchair with a single punch
He traps Riehlvelt under a flagstone
He wraps the Twin Snake around Riehlvelt's neck and feigns pressing its switch
He uses Ren to extinguish Riehlvelt's aura
questions.explanation: Gon takes the Twin Snake, wraps it around Riehlvelt's neck, and only pretends to activate the electricity; fear makes Riehlvelt lose consciousness.

questions.prompt: What did the referee award Gon for striking Hisoka with the shattered flagstone and following attack?
options: A critical hit
An automatic disqualification
A ring-out victory
A penalty point
questions.explanation: The referee awarded Gon a critical hit for the flagstone strategy and the punch that followed, putting him briefly ahead on points.

source.title: Episode 36 (2011) - A Big Debt × And × A Small Kick

questions.prompt: When did Hisoka attach Bungee Gum to Gon, enabling the pull that set up Hisoka's decisive punch?
options: When Gon returned Hisoka's number plate
During Hisoka's personality analysis of Gon
When Gon first entered the arena
After the referee awarded Gon his critical hit
questions.explanation: Gyo reveals the gum on Gon's cheek; Hisoka explains that he attached it during the personality analysis.

source.title: Episode 36 (2011) - A Big Debt × And × A Small Kick

questions.prompt: What Nen state does Kurapika's Chain Jail impose on a Phantom Troupe member when it ensnares him?
options: Zetsu, preventing the captive from using aura
Ren, forcing the captive's aura to expand
In, making the captive invisible
Gyo, revealing every hidden object
questions.explanation: Kurapika explains that Chain Jail activates Zetsu on a Troupe member, which is why Uvogin cannot break it with aura.

questions.prompt: Why does Kurapika choose Uvogin as his first Phantom Troupe target?
options: Uvogin is the only Troupe member who cannot use Nen
Uvogin is the physically strongest, so containing him would suggest the other Spiders could also be contained
Uvogin personally sold the Kurta eyes at the auction
Uvogin is the Troupe member who betrayed Chrollo
questions.explanation: Kurapika selects the strongest member in physical strength as a test: if Uvogin cannot break Chain Jail, the others should be helpless in it as well.

questions.prompt: What rule does Kurapika place on Uvogin with Judgment Chain before asking where the Phantom Troupe is hiding?
options: Uvogin must answer all of Kurapika's questions
Uvogin must never use physical strength again
Uvogin must lead Kurapika to the auction
Uvogin must reveal his Nen category to Chrollo
questions.explanation: Kurapika's rule requires Uvogin to answer his questions; Uvogin refuses to answer the location question, so the Judgment Chain kills him.

questions.prompt: When Chrollo uses Indoor Fish on an assassin in episode 51, what happens under the ability's shown rule?
options: The victim is kept alive inside until Chrollo opens the window, then dies immediately
The victim is transformed into a fish and can escape through any door
The victim's memories are erased but the body survives
The victim can leave safely as soon as Chrollo closes the book
questions.explanation: Indoor Fish tears the assassin apart while keeping him alive; when Chrollo opens the window, the ability's rule causes the assassin to die instantly.

questions.prompt: Which two conditions does Kurapika place on Chrollo during the hostage exchange?
options: He may not use Nen and may not contact any Phantom Troupe member
He must leave Yorknew and surrender his stolen book
He must reveal the Kurta massacre and return the Scarlet Eyes
He must fight Hisoka and remain inside the airship
questions.explanation: Kurapika's Judgment Chain forbids Chrollo from using Nen and from contacting any member of the Phantom Troupe.

questions.prompt: What does Pakunoda do immediately before Kurapika's Judgment Chain kills her after the hostage exchange?
options: She fires six Memory Bombs bullets containing her memories into six founding Troupe members
She burns Chrollo's book and flees Yorknew alone
She uses Dowsing Chain to locate Kurapika
She challenges Hisoka to a duel in the airship
questions.explanation: Pakunoda fires her maximum six memory bullets into Feitan, Phinks, Machi, Nobunaga, Shalnark, and Franklin; then the chain activates and kills her.

questions.prompt: According to Eta's explanation when Gon enters Greed Island, what must a player collect to clear the game?
options: All 40 spell cards
All 100 restricted (specified-slot) cards
The three cards in the special case
A complete set of free-slot cards
questions.explanation: Eta explains that the binder has 100 restricted card slots and that clearing Greed Island requires collecting all of those cards.

questions.prompt: Which keyword spell makes Greed Island's card binder appear?
options: Gain
Book
Accompany
Leave
questions.explanation: Eta tells Gon that saying “Book” materializes the binder used to store Greed Island cards.

source.title: End × And × Beginning — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: Which Greed Island keyword spell changes a card back into its material item form?
options: Book
Gain
Trace
Contact
questions.explanation: The ring's “Gain” spell materializes an item represented by a card; Eta explains this while introducing the game rules.

source.title: End × And × Beginning — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: During the final exchange of the dodgeball match against Razor, who used Bungee Gum to stop Razor's returning ball?
options: Gon
Killua
Hisoka
Goreinu
questions.explanation: After Gon’s powered throw, Hisoka used Bungee Gum to catch and redirect Razor’s counter, pushing Razor out of bounds and securing the win.

source.title: Bargain × And × Deal — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: What is the name of Genthru's ability that he uses by gripping a target and detonating an explosion?
options: Countdown
Little Flower
Ripper Cyclotron
Deep Purple
questions.explanation: Genthru uses Little Flower to explode what he is holding; Gon counters by protecting his wrist with aura.

source.title: Victor × And × Loser — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: When Gon and Killua used Accompany on the player name “Nigg,” where did the card actually take them?
options: To Ging at the Greed Island starting point
To Kite near the Chimera Ant nest
To Razor's lighthouse
To Battera's mansion
questions.explanation: Ging had arranged the game’s transport so Accompany on “Nigg” would send Gon to Kite; Magnetic Force was the route intended for Ging himself.

options: A piece of Kite's Crazy Slots
Illumi's needle
A dart from the Ortho Siblings
A transmitter planted by Morel
questions.explanation: Killua realized Illumi’s voice and the urge to flee came from a needle implanted by Illumi, then pulled it out and immediately defeated Rammot.

Battle Cantabile
Rental Pod
Satellite Dragonflies

questions.prompt: How did Killua neutralize the Ortho Siblings' supposedly fatal final dart?
options: He reflected it with Bungee Gum
He used a suction cup to catch it when it materialized
He destroyed it with Godspeed before it appeared
He substituted a yo-yo for his head
questions.explanation: Killua predicted the final dart’s location from the double-out rule, placed a suction cup over that spot, and caught the dart as it materialized.

source.title: Ikalgo × And × Lightning — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: How many rooms does Knov's Hide and Seek Nen space contain?
questions.explanation: Knov explains that Hide and Seek creates a Nen space consisting of 21 isolated rooms arranged across four floors.

source.title: Doubt × And × Hesitation — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: What did Morel use to defeat Leol after Leol activated the stolen Inamura ability?
options: A poisonous smoke compound
Carbon dioxide produced and concentrated with his lungs and smoke
A direct Deep Purple clone attack
A water counter from Knuckle
questions.explanation: Morel increased the carbon-dioxide concentration underwater using his lungs and smoke, causing Leol to lose consciousness and his ability to fail.

source.title: Return × And × Retire — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: Which Royal Guard's wing scales hypnotized and dazed the citizens marching toward the palace?
options: Neferpitou
Menthuthuyoupi
Shaiapouf
Meruem
questions.explanation: The infiltration team identifies the marching citizens as hypnotized by Shaiapouf’s wing scales.

questions.prompt: Which named attack did Netero use to drive Meruem into the underground tomb at the start of their decisive battle?
options: The Ninety-Ninth Hand
Zero Hand
Jupiter
Jajanken: Rock
questions.explanation: Netero activates the 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva and uses the Ninety-Ninth Hand, whose impact sends both fighters down into the tomb.

source.title: Great Power × And × Ultimate Power — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: Which attack did Netero use immediately before activating the Poor Man's Rose against Meruem?
options: Ninety-Ninth Hand
Zero Hand
Dragon Dive
Little Flower
questions.explanation: After Meruem tears off Netero’s limbs, Netero fires the 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva’s Zero Hand; when it fails to stop the King, he activates the implanted Poor Man’s Rose.

source.title: Zero × And × Rose — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: According to the ending shown in episode 136, who was the Chimera Ant child Shidore before reincarnation?
options: Kurt
Reina
Komugi
Ponzu
questions.explanation: The episode reveals that Shidore is the reincarnation of Reina; her mother recognizes her when she returns to the NGL village.

source.title: Homecoming × And × Real Name — Hunterpedia episode reference

questions.prompt: When Neferpitou summons Doctor Blythe while being thrown away by Netero, what movement restriction does the ability impose?
options: Pitou cannot move more than 20 meters from Doctor Blythe's original position.
Pitou must remain within 5 meters of the person being healed.
Pitou cannot move until the healing is complete, regardless of distance.
Pitou can move freely, but Doctor Blythe cannot be summoned again for one hour.
questions.explanation: Doctor Blythe is stationary after being summoned, and Pitou cannot move beyond 20 meters from it.

questions.prompt: Why does Menthuthuyoupi fail to see A.P.R. when Knuckle attacks during the palace invasion?
options: Meleoron hides Knuckle and A.P.R. with God's Accomplice.
Knuckle temporarily removes A.P.R. from Youpi to avoid detection.
A.P.R. is invisible to Royal Guards by its basic Nen property.
Zeno's Dragon Dive disrupts Youpi's eyesight at that moment.
questions.explanation: Meleoron's God's Accomplice makes the cooperating users invisible, so Knuckle and the attached A.P.R. cannot be seen by Youpi.

questions.prompt: What practical limitation affects Meleoron's use of Perfect Plan during the palace operation?
options: It consumes oxygen, so he has to deactivate it briefly to breathe.
It drains his blood, so it can be used only once per hour.
It prevents him from moving, so he can activate it only while standing still.
It works only inside Morel's Smoky Jail.
questions.explanation: Meleoron repeatedly has to turn Perfect Plan off briefly to catch his breath and conserve oxygen.

questions.prompt: What immediate tactical opening lets Knuckle land eight hits on Menthuthuyoupi in episode 118?
options: Killua's lightning temporarily paralyzes Youpi.
Shoot's Hotel Rafflesia traps Youpi's arms.
Morel's Smoky Jail seals Youpi's aura.
Meleoron makes Knuckle invisible and immobilizes Youpi.
questions.explanation: Killua strikes Youpi with lightning, paralyzing him for several seconds; Knuckle uses that opening to land eight hits.

questions.prompt: What attack pattern does Meruem identify while analyzing Netero's 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva?
options: Netero must put his hands together before launching an attack.
Netero must step backward before every third strike.
The Bodhisattva can attack only when Meruem is facing it.
Netero's attacks always repeat in groups of ten.
questions.explanation: Meruem recognizes that Netero has to bring his hands together before the Bodhisattva's attack is activated.

questions.prompt: What is the immediate result of Netero's Zero Hand before he activates the Poor Man's Rose?
options: It does little to Meruem; Netero then uses the Rose as his final resort.
It kills Meruem, but the Rose is used to destroy the palace afterward.
It restores Netero's lost arm and leg, allowing him to continue fighting.
It traps Meruem underground until the Hunters can capture him.
questions.explanation: Zero Hand is Netero's strongest Nen attack, but Meruem survives it with little effective damage; Netero then triggers the implanted Poor Man's Rose.

questions.prompt: What does Neferpitou's post-mortem Terpsichora do immediately after Pitou is killed by Gon?
options: It keeps Pitou's corpse moving long enough to rip off Gon's right arm.
It resurrects Pitou with full consciousness and restores Doctor Blythe.
It seals Gon's Nen and prevents him from using Jajanken.
It transfers Pitou's aura into Killua's body.
questions.explanation: Pitou's devotion to the King causes Terpsichora to animate the corpse after death; the puppet-like body tears off Gon's right arm.

questions.prompt: As the wager in Meruem's contest with Pouf and Youpi is set, what restriction does Meruem accept for his own search?
options: He may use En no more than once.
He may use En only for ten seconds at a time.
He may use En only inside the West tower.
He must give up En entirely and search by sight.
questions.explanation: Meruem accepts the handicap that he may activate En only once while searching for the other intruders.

questions.prompt: How does Palm help keep Komugi from being detected when Meruem uses En?
options: She covers Komugi with her hair, hiding her presence from the King.
She places Komugi inside a Smoky Jail made by Morel.
She uses Wink Blue to erase Komugi's aura.
She disguises Komugi as a Hunter's corpse.
questions.explanation: Palm reasons that Meruem did not detect Komugi because Palm covered her with her hair; she keeps Komugi hidden in that way.

questions.prompt: According to the explanation of the Miniature Rose's aftereffect, what happens to people who survive its initial explosion?
options: A poison degrades their organs and continues producing poison until they die.
Their Nen is permanently sealed, but the poison itself disappears within minutes.
They become immune to all other toxins but lose their memories.
They can survive if they remain within Meruem's aura.
questions.explanation: Episode 134 explains that the Rose's poison degrades organs and keeps emitting more poison until the victim dies.

questions.prompt: What does the first election rule chosen from Ging's proposal establish about Hunters?
options: Every Hunter is both a candidate and a voter.
Only Zodiacs may vote, while all Hunters may run.
Only licensed Hunters with two-star status may be candidates.
Hunters may vote, but candidates must be nominated by the Zodiacs.
questions.explanation: Rule 1 explicitly makes all Hunters both candidates and voters.

questions.prompt: Under Ging's election rules, what happens to a ballot that does not contain the voter's name?
options: It is invalid and does not count.
It counts only if the voter has a valid Hunter License.
It is counted anonymously after Beans verifies it.
It is added to the leading candidate's total.
questions.explanation: Rule 4 requires voters to put their names on ballots; anonymous or nameless votes are invalid.

questions.prompt: What additional enforcement measure does Pariston propose after the early election rounds fail to reach 95% turnout?
options: Hunters who abstain or submit invalid ballots temporarily lose their licenses, while retaining the right to vote.
Any Hunter who votes for a losing candidate permanently loses their license.
The Zodiacs may cast two votes each in the next round.
All absent Hunters are automatically assigned to Pariston.
questions.explanation: Pariston proposes temporary license confiscation for abstentions or invalid votes, while explicitly preserving those Hunters' voting rights.

questions.prompt: What conditional instruction does Killua give Nanika to get past Silva's restriction at Kukuroo Mountain?
options: Kill his mother if they have not left in half an hour; kiss him if they have.
Kill Silva if he refuses; heal Gon if he agrees.
Destroy the estate if Illumi appears; hide if he does not.
Put every butler to sleep if Killua is delayed; wake them after one hour.
questions.explanation: Killua tells Nanika to kill his mother if they have not left within half an hour, or kiss him on the cheek if they have left.

questions.prompt: What does Pariston do immediately after winning the final Hunter Chairman election?
options: He appoints Cheadle vice-chairman and then resigns as chairman.
He appoints Ging vice-chairman and orders a new election.
He dissolves the Zodiac Council and keeps the chairmanship.
He gives the chairmanship to Leorio and leaves the Association.
questions.explanation: After the ninth round meets all conditions and Pariston wins, he names Cheadle vice-chairman and immediately resigns.

questions.prompt: During the Greed Island dodgeball match, how many numbered anthropomorphic Nen beasts does Razor create for his side?
options: Four
Eight
Fourteen
Fifteen
questions.explanation: Razor's ability is called 14 Devils, but it produces eight numbered beasts (0 through 7): seven can act as teammates and one can referee. The other six of the fourteen are part of the ability's broader game-fiction framing, not additional numbered beasts on the court.

questions.prompt: In Razor's dodgeball game, what numbered Devil results when Devil No. 6 fuses with Devil No. 7?
options: No. 11
No. 12
No. 13
No. 14
questions.explanation: The fusion's number is the sum of its component numbers: 6 + 7 produces Devil No. 13. The fused Devil catches a throw that an individual Devil could not.

questions.prompt: What interest does Knuckle's A.P.R. add, and how often, while its target remains within the ability's effective distance?
options: 5% every 5 seconds
10% every 10 seconds
10% every 60 seconds
20% every 10 seconds
questions.explanation: A.P.R. adds interest equal to 10% of the borrowed aura every 10 seconds, provided the target is within 50 meters of Knuckle. The debt can eventually force bankruptcy.

questions.prompt: Which target is explicitly outside the things Shizuku's conjured vacuum Blinky can inhale?
options: Blood spilled on the floor
A non-Nen metal object
A living person
A corpse
questions.explanation: Blinky can remove nonliving matter, including crime-scene evidence, but it cannot inhale something Shizuku considers living or an object made of Nen.

questions.prompt: In the 2011 anime, what exact phrase releases Countdown from a person who has been marked by Genthru?
options: I defeated the Bomber
I caught the Bomber
The Bomber is gone
Release the Bomber
questions.explanation: The victim must touch Genthru and say "I caught the Bomber." Episode 75 shows Abengane use that exact phrase to remove the Countdown mark from himself.

source.title: Ging's Friends × And × True Friends — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: Which rule about wishes is explicitly associated with Nanika's power?
options: The same person may ask for consecutive wishes only after saying Nanika's name
The same person cannot ask Alluka for consecutive wishes
Only a Zoldyck may ask Nanika for a wish
A wish must always be made outside Kukuroo Mountain
questions.explanation: One of the rules established through the Zoldyck family's experiments is that the same person cannot ask Alluka for consecutive wishes. Killua's special command is an exception to some ordinary wish restrictions, not a general repeal of this rule for everyone.

questions.prompt: At the Hunter Association election, what does Leorio's remote Nen punch hit on Ging?
options: His left shoulder
His chest
His jaw
The microphone in his hand
questions.explanation: After Ging dismisses the need to visit Gon, Leorio projects a punch that strikes Ging squarely in the jaw and sends him flying from his seat.

source.title: Join Battle × And × Open Battle — Hunterpedia

questions.prompt: What is the immediate result of Netero's Zero Hand against Meruem?
options: It kills Meruem instantly
It seals Meruem inside the tomb
It destroys the underground tomb but leaves Meruem alive
It restores Netero's severed limbs
questions.explanation: The 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva's Zero Hand devastates the underground tomb, but Meruem survives the blast with little apparent damage and praises the attack.

questions.prompt: What happens to Shaiapouf's small Beelzebub clones when Morel's smoke puppets break them in episode 120?
options: They turn into ordinary smoke
They reform
They become permanently unconscious
They merge into Menthuthuyoupi
questions.explanation: The broken miniature Pouf bodies reform, making the clones appear invulnerable to Morel's attacks. Pouf uses them to observe events throughout the palace.

questions.prompt: How does Palm's Black Widow ability manifest when she confronts Killua?
options: Her crystal ball becomes a shield
Her hair wraps around her body as a black dress and wide-brim hat
Her scales turn into metal armor
Her eyes project a beam that freezes Killua
questions.explanation: Palm wraps her hair around herself, forming the Black Widow's black dress and wide-brim-hat appearance before attacking Killua.

questions.prompt: What two properties does Hisoka say make up Bungee Gum?
options: Rubber and gum
Paper and ink
